senses.gloss: f. (preced. art.) bow-shaped handle of a borer, ‘bow-drill’ (v. Sm. Ant.3 s. v. Terebra).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:17">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:17">XIV</cite>), 17 <he>מטלטלין את הקשט׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>הקַשְׁתָּ׳</he>) you may handle the bow-drill (on the Sabbath); <he>ולא יקדיח בק׳ וכ׳</he> but you must not bore (a wine cask &c.) as you do on week days.
